question: What does the idiom 'To grasp at straws' mean?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To grasp at straws"** means to try desperate or unlikely measures in a hopeless situation. (असफल स्थिति में निराशा में कुछ करने की कोशिश करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He was grasping at straws, hoping to find a way to save his failing business.
 
 
• The phrase suggests an act of desperation when someone is out of options and tries anything, even if it seems irrational or unlikely to work. (यह किसी भी चीज़ को आज़माने की निराशाजनक स्थिति को दर्शाता है, भले ही वह अव्यावहारिक या असंभव हो।)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To win easily** (आसानी से जीतना): Achieving success or victory without much difficulty.
 
 
• **Example:** The team managed to win the match easily due to their excellent preparation.
 
 

 
• **To show courage** (साहस दिखाना): Demonstrating bravery or fearlessness in difficult situations.
 
 
• **Example:** She showed great courage during the rescue operation.
 
 

 
• **To make careful decisions** (सावधानीपूर्वक निर्णय लेना): To think thoroughly and act cautiously before making a choice.
 
 
• **Example:** The CEO made careful decisions to ensure the company’s growth.
